answer: A ridge of checkpoints stops sybil floods when passage costs work, not accounts. Passage takes four steps: pay a toll of 10 tokens at the first gate, solve a rotating cipher puzzle at that gate within five minutes, carry a ferrous-stamped receipt for the puzzle, and face spot-checks where peers re-run one passage in ten. A failed check burns the toll and freezes the identity for seven days. Forging 1,000 fakes needs 10,000 toll tokens, 1,000 five-minute puzzles, and surviving 100 spot-checks. Like a mountain ridge, it is crossed one verified gate at a time, never by sheer numbers.
